program.name: Bell Circuit
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: One kettlebell, full-body circuits: a swing, a squat, a press and a row every round.
program.about: Full-body circuits with one kettlebell. Every round has a swing or a snatch, a squat, a press and a row, with a breather between rounds. Two days alternate the moves. It is strength and conditioning in one, about thirty minutes. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
